title: Individuals and Families
heading: IELTS Vocabulary & Reading Practice

passages.title: The Role of Parents in a Child’s Development
passages.text: Parents play a crucial role in shaping a child's behavior, values, and mindset. They provide emotional support, set rules, and teach children responsibility. Without proper parental guidance, children may struggle with discipline and decision-making.

vocabulary.sourceText: Crucial role – vai trò quan trọng (synonym: vital role)
Emotional support – hỗ trợ tinh thần
Responsibility – trách nhiệm (synonym: duty, obligation)

vocabulary.meaning: sự hướng dẫn của cha mẹ
vocabulary.sourceText: Parental guidance – sự hướng dẫn của cha mẹ

passages.title: Family as a Support System
passages.text: A strong family acts as a support system, offering both financial assistance and moral encouragement. In times of hardship, the presence of caring family members helps individuals overcome difficulties more easily.

vocabulary.sourceText: Support system – hệ thống hỗ trợ
Financial assistance – hỗ trợ tài chính
Moral encouragement – khích lệ tinh thần

passages.title: Shared Responsibilities at Home
passages.text: Sharing household chores among family members teaches teamwork and respect. Whether it’s cooking, cleaning, or grocery shopping, dividing tasks prevents burden and promotes family harmony.

vocabulary.sourceText: Household chores – việc nhà (synonym: domestic tasks)
Teamwork – làm việc nhóm
Burden – gánh nặng (synonym: load, strain)

vocabulary.meaning: sự hòa thuận trong gia đình
vocabulary.sourceText: Family harmony – sự hòa thuận trong gia đình

passages.title: Individual Responsibility in Society
passages.text: Every individual has a social responsibility to act ethically and contribute positively to the community. Actions like volunteering, recycling, and obeying laws demonstrate civic duty.

vocabulary.sourceText: Social responsibility – trách nhiệm xã hội
Volunteering – hoạt động tình nguyện
Civic duty – nghĩa vụ công dân

passages.title: Intergenerational Relationships
passages.text: Grandparents often provide wisdom, traditions, and a sense of belonging. Interactions between generations can strengthen family bonds and instill mutual respect and empathy.

vocabulary.sourceText: Wisdom – sự khôn ngoan
Belonging – cảm giác thuộc về
Family bonds – mối liên kết gia đình
Respect – sự tôn trọng

passages.title: Work-Life Balance for Families
passages.text: Balancing professional duties and family responsibilities is essential for maintaining a healthy family dynamic. Parents who spend quality time with children foster emotional connection and better behavior.

vocabulary.meaning: cân bằng công việc và cuộc sống
vocabulary.sourceText: Work-life balance – cân bằng công việc và cuộc sống

vocabulary.meaning: mối quan hệ gia đình lành mạnh
vocabulary.sourceText: Healthy family dynamic – mối quan hệ gia đình lành mạnh
Emotional connection – sự gắn kết cảm xúc

passages.title: Education Begins at Home
passages.text: Before formal schooling, children learn values, language, and basic manners from family members. This early foundation of education is crucial for future academic and social success.

vocabulary.sourceText: Values – giá trị sống
Foundation – nền tảng (synonym: basis)
Manners – cách cư xử

passages.title: Family Traditions and Culture
passages.text: Family traditions, such as shared meals and celebrations, help preserve cultural identity. They also foster unity and a sense of continuity across generations.

vocabulary.sourceText: Traditions – truyền thống
Cultural identity – bản sắc văn hóa
Continuity – sự liên tục, tiếp nối (synonym: permanence)

passages.title: Supporting Elderly Family Members
passages.text: As people age, they may require caregiving and emotional presence. Families are often responsible for ensuring elderly well-being, either through direct care or assistance.

vocabulary.sourceText: Caregiving – chăm sóc

vocabulary.meaning: sức khỏe tinh thần và thể chất của người già
vocabulary.sourceText: Elderly well-being – sức khỏe tinh thần và thể chất của người già

passages.title: Family Conflicts and Resolution
passages.text: Conflicts are inevitable in any family, but effective communication, empathy, and conflict resolution skills can prevent long-term damage. Listening and compromising are key to restoring peace.

vocabulary.sourceText: Conflict resolution – giải quyết mâu thuẫn
Empathy – sự thấu cảm
Communication – giao tiếp
Peace – sự hòa bình

reading: Families play a crucial role in shaping an individual’s development from early childhood to adulthood. Parents are often the primary influence, providing emotional support, guidance, and discipline that help children form values and behavioral patterns. Without such guidance, young people may struggle with decision-making and social adjustment.

In addition to parents, the family unit acts as a support system during times of difficulty. Financial assistance, moral encouragement, and emotional presence from family members can significantly reduce stress and improve resilience. This support becomes especially important in societies facing economic instability or social change.

Modern lifestyles, however, have altered traditional family structures. Increased work demands and urban migration often reduce the time families spend together. As a result, communication may weaken, leading to misunderstandings and emotional distance among members. Experts suggest that maintaining work-life balance is essential for preserving healthy family relationships.

Despite these challenges, families continue to play an essential role in cultural transmission. Traditions, shared meals, and celebrations help preserve identity and strengthen intergenerational bonds. Elderly members often contribute wisdom and life experience, while younger generations bring innovation and energy, creating a balanced dynamic.

Finally, conflicts are inevitable in any family setting. However, through empathy, active communication, and compromise, these conflicts can be resolved effectively. Strong family relationships depend not on the absence of problems, but on the ability to manage them constructively.

paragraphs: Families play an important role in shaping individual __________(1) from early life. Parents provide emotional __________(2), discipline, and guidance. A family acts as a __________(3) system during difficult times, offering financial and emotional help.
However, modern lifestyles have reduced family __________(4), which may lead to communication problems and emotional __________(5). Maintaining work-life __________(6) is therefore essential.

Families also preserve cultural __________(7) through shared activities. Elderly members contribute __________(8), while younger generations provide innovation and __________(9). Despite differences, family __________(10) can be resolved through empathy and communication.

translation.text: Gia đình đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc hình thành hành vi và giá trị của mỗi cá nhân. Cha mẹ cung cấp sự hỗ trợ tinh thần và hướng dẫn con cái. Trong xã hội hiện đại, việc duy trì cân bằng giữa công việc và cuộc sống là rất quan trọng để giữ gìn mối quan hệ gia đình. Mâu thuẫn là điều không thể tránh khỏi, nhưng có thể được giải quyết thông qua sự thấu cảm và giao tiếp hiệu quả.
